measurement_scope.server_count: requested metadata; exact observed source listening, URDF payload, LDS registration, and terminal aggregation counts are retained per run
measurement_scope.cpu: Aggregation Server plus LDS interval CPU-time delta divided by actual wall time; equivalent fully used cores
measurement_scope.memory: Aggregation Server plus LDS resident working set; MiB
measurement_scope.network: the active distributed matrix sums all bidirectional TCP/IP bytes between the physical source and aggregation hosts, divided by actual interval; MiB/s. The capture is dominated by OPC UA and also contains a small SSH control contribution. Legacy runs retain their manifest definition

summary_method.curve: per-run linear interpolation to a one-second grid followed by the pointwise mean; intervals longer than 5 s remain missing
summary_method.band: pointwise minimum and maximum across available runs; coverage fields record the contributor count
summary_method.display_smoothing: centered 31-second arithmetic moving average applied to each interpolated run before plotting the pointwise mean and band; numeric summaries remain unsmoothed
summary_method.initial: mean of pointwise mean curve from 0 through 10 s
summary_method.final: mean of the final 30 s of the selected display window; coverage fields record the minimum contributing run count
summary_method.network_volume: sum of rate times actual sample interval for samples whose timestamps fall inside the selected display window; suspension gaps are not imputed
